body.x: OptAI Inc. (CEO Jaeho Lee) participated in CES 2026, the world’s largest IT and technology exhibition, held in Las Vegas, the United States, from January 6 to 9 (local time), and took part in an interview at the AVING Media Stage inside the Seoul Pavilion during the exhibition period.

Founded in 2021, OptAI is a deep-tech startup with specialized expertise in AI optimization. As on-device and edge AI technologies rapidly spread across global IT, consumer electronics, and automotive industries, the company provides model-optimization and inference-acceleration technologies that enable optimal efficiency across diverse applications.

OptAI has previously collaborated with leading Korean conglomerates such as LG Electronics, LG Uplus, Hanwha Aerospace, and Hyundai Mobis, demonstrating strong technological capabilities by delivering solutions applicable to their services and manufacturing sites. At CES 2026, which the company joined to expand into global markets, OptAI further validated its capabilities on the world stage by being selected as a CES Innovation Award winner.

At this year’s CES, OptAI showcased “OptHancer,” an end-to-end platform designed to resolve bottlenecks that arise when running large-scale AI models on hardware and systems with limited resources. The platform optimizes language, vision, and multimodal models in environments using the latest mobile processors and NPUs (neural processing units), thereby maximizing both performance and power efficiency.

OptHancer features a “Surgical Model Re-Architecture” approach combined with hardware-aware optimization. This design supports a wide range of models, including large language models such as EXAONE, LLaMA, Gemma, and Qwen; vision models in the YOLO and DeTR families; and multimodal models such as LLaVA and Qwen2-VL.

In addition, the platform automates complex model compression and deployment processes, reducing the burden of AI adoption for enterprises and enabling high-performance AI even on low-specification, low-power devices, according to the company.

Junyoung Seo, COO of OptAI, said, “OptHancer is recognized for its value and differentiation in that it goes beyond simple model lightweighting to deliver optimization at a level that is truly usable in real industrial settings.” He added, “With these characteristics, companies can reduce dependence on the cloud, utilize on-device AI more stably, and expect to significantly improve cost efficiency across industries through AI adoption.”

Seo continued, “Building on our participation in CES and the Innovation Award recognition, we aim to accelerate collaboration with overseas companies, particularly by expanding partnerships across semiconductors, mobility, and telecommunications,” adding, “Based on our vision of supporting any model on any hardware environment, we will continue to lead the field of on-device AI optimization.”

body.x: The company participated in CES 2026, held from January 6 to 9, as part of the Seoul Pavilion located in Eureka Park, the startup-focused exhibition area. The Seoul Pavilion at CES 2026 supported a total of 70 startups with participation from 19 startup support organizations based in Seoul, including the Seoul Business Agency, district offices, related institutions, and universities. The 70 exhibiting companies were composed of startups offering products and services based on advanced technologies such as AI, mobility, and healthcare. Among them, selected outstanding companies were given the opportunity to participate in CES’s official media event, Unveiled.
